method: Native45wall seconds at a verified real-terrain comparison station (run: mapped asphalt Quai du Premier Président Pérevier; slope: admitted OSM way with no known acoustic floor):5s idle, walk5–15s, Shift-run15–25s, stop25–32s, strafe32–37s, rest37–45s. Actual keyboard and unchanged collision kernel, no forced path or synthetic relocation during recording.
capture: Native game loop, canvas up to8fps VP9 plus actual post-limiter Opus bus; no time acceleration or re-encoding, packet-copy index only. Canvas movies exclude HTML controls; screenshots retain actual interfaces. Software timings include recording and are not physical GPU FPS.
